messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: autoscale-group 'redwood-runtime-prod' reporting sustained queue_depth > 1200 and tokens/sec spike; throttle events increasing (5m rate = 18/min). severity: P1. link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/autoscale/overview

oncall-bot: Paging oncall -> @alex wang :rotating_light: (policy: p1-paging)

alex wang: Acked. I'm on it. grabbing context from dashboards now.

dena patel: saw some customer reports from Support: a few 504s when generating long-chat responses. limited scope — not all customers.

raj singh: I can join for mitigation. sounds like burst capacity didn't kick or got throttled. can we confirm current pool usage and pending scale ops?

alex wang: checking nodes: current pool 48/50 GPUs, cpu/k8s autoscaler triggered but new nodes are stuck in Pending due to image pull rate limit on one AZ. logs show kubelet backoff.

alex wang: quick mitigation plan: 1) enable emergency-burst (allow +10 nodes) 2) route traffic to fallback model variant (quantized) for non-enterprise customers 3) temporarily relax queue-depth alert debounce

raj singh: +1. I can flip routing and emergency-burst. dena, can you confirm customer segmentting rules? we should avoid routing regulated customers to fallback.

dena patel: confirmed. will annotate rollout with allowed_customer_tags. support-bot: posted list of affected customers to incident channel.

ops-bot: exec: runbook "autoscale-p1" has steps for emergency-burst and routing.

alex wang: executing step 1: enabling emergency-burst: 
```
# grant burst capacity
kubectl -n infra annotate nodepool/gpu-prod autoscaler.alpha.kubernetes.io/override-burst=10
curl -X POST https://orchestrator.internal/api/v1/pools/gpu-prod/override -d '{"burst":10}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer **redacted**'
```

raj singh: step 2: routing change. rolling traffic to quantized-variant for default tier (30% traffic)
```
curl -X POST https://router.internal/release -d '{"service":"generation","variant":"quant-001","traffic_shift":0.3}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer **redacted**'
```

alex wang: confirmed nodes are moving; Pending->Running on 5 new instances. queue depth trending down from 1350 to 680 in last 7m. tokens/sec also decreasing. throttles still present but falling.

dena patel: support updated customers. re: 504s — majority resolved after the routing change. a couple of enterprise customers still saw degraded p99 latency; will follow up via account teams.

ops-bot: Incident note: mitigation in progress. please post any config changes for postmortem.

alex wang: Logging steps for post-incident: created INC-4321 in Jira (https://jira.redwood/browse/INC-4321) assigned to eng-sre (raj) and oncall (alex).

raj singh: follow-ups I'm adding: image pull retry policy tweak, AZ spin-up limits, and fallback capacity health checks. Also propose alert retune:
- increase queue_depth alert threshold from 1000 -> 1500, but add a new indicator for tokens/sec per-second per-node normalized metric
- add alert on throttle_event_rate > 10/min with 3m eval and 3m debounce
- add a dashboard panel 'autoscale-health' combining queue_depth, tokens/sec, throttle_rate, node_pending_count

dena patel: +1 on dashboard. also add customer-impact dimension to the alert so Support can be paged only if impacted customers > 0.

alex wang: let's patch the alert rules now in staging then ship to prod. here's a draft rule to discuss:
```
alert: AutoscaleQueueDepthBurst
expr: max_over_time(queue_depth[3m]) > 1500 and increase(throttle_events_total[5m]) > 5
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Autoscale queue depth and throttle spike"
  runbook: "https://wiki.redwood/ops/autoscale-p1"
```

raj singh: also suggest adding a normalized tokens/sec per-node metric: tokens_per_node = tokens_total / max(1, node_running_count). alert on tokens_per_node > 1200 for 5m.

dena patel: we should also reduce noise: add a silence window for low-traffic hours on non-prod alerts and increase min-eval-window for queue_depth from 1m -> 3m.

alex wang: I updated the staging alert in grafana and added the 'autoscale-health' dashboard draft (link: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd1234/autoscale-health). please review.

ops-bot: CHANGELOG: alert-rule 'autoscale-queue-depth' updated in staging by alex wang.

raj singh: After-action items (added to INC-4321):
- (P0) Fix image pull QPS constraint in AZ-2 (infra)
- (P1) Implement fallback traffic gating by customer tag (router)
- (P1) Add throttle_event_rate alert and dashboard panel (obs)
- (P2) Tune debounce windows and eval intervals for queue_depth alerts
- (P2) Postmortem to include runbook clarity around emergency-burst & routing

dena patel: I'll coordinate customer comms for the enterprise customers impacted and loop in AMs.

alex wang: handing off to next oncall @raj singh. I'm going offline for 30m but reachable via phone for escalation.

oncall-bot: Handoff: oncall window 02:00-10:00 UTC -> new owner @raj singh.

raj singh: taking ownership. will monitor dashboards for 60m then close the incident if stable.

support-bot: Noted: final impact summary queued for INC-4321 and customer comms draft in drive (https://drive.redwood/INC-4321/comms).

ops-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> status: stabilizing. please file postmortem within 72h.

alex wang: closing thread on my side. great quick teamwork :thumbsup:

raj singh: thanks all — will update once incident is fully closed and alerts pushed to prod.
